label: Work and Money
heading: Egyptian Arabic Work and Money — 40 Words

examples.arabic: بابايا بيشتغل في شركة كبيرة، وماما بتعمل لنا أكل حلو.
examples.english: My father works in a big company, and mom makes delicious food for us.
examples.transliteration: Babaya biyeshtaghal fee sherka kebira, we mama betamel lena akl helw.

examples.arabic: اخويا الكبير بيشتغل في شركة في مصر الجديدة
examples.english: My older brother works in a company in Heliopolis.
examples.transliteration: Akhoya elkebir biyeshtaghal fi sherka fi Masr el-Gedida

examples.arabic: عايز يقدم على وظيفة في شركة الإعلانات الكبيرة.
examples.english: He wants to apply for a job at the big ad company.
examples.transliteration: 3ayiz yiqaddim 3ala waẓifa fi shariket el-i3lanat el-kabira.

examples.arabic: الحمد لله كويس وانت عامل ايه النهارده في الشغل
examples.english: Thank God I am good and you how are you doing today at work?
examples.transliteration: Elhamdullelah kwayes wenta amel eh ennaharda fel shoghl

examples.arabic: وانت عامل ايه النهاردة في الشغل بتاعك
examples.english: And you, how are you doing today in your work?
examples.transliteration: Wenta amel eh ennaharda fel shoghl betaak
examples.storyTitle: A New Day with the Family

examples.arabic: احنا اتكلمنا شوية وبعدين رحت الشغل
examples.english: We talked a little and then I went to work.
examples.transliteration: ehna etkallemna shwaya w baadein roht elshoghl

examples.arabic: هما ودوا كريم للدكتور بسرعة.
examples.english: They took Karim to the doctor quickly.
examples.transliteration: Homa waddaw Karim lel doktor be sor3a.

examples.arabic: منى وصلت، قلقانة. صباح الخير يا دكتور! قالت.
examples.english: Mona arrived, anxious. "Good morning, Doctor!" she said.
examples.transliteration: Mona wasalet, qalqana. "Sabah el-kheir ya doctor!" qalet.

examples.arabic: الحمد لله كويس وانت عامل ايه النهارده في الشغل
examples.english: Thank God I am good and you how are you doing today at work?
examples.transliteration: Elhamdullelah kwayes wenta amel eh ennaharda fel shoghl

examples.arabic: وانت عامل ايه النهاردة في الشغل بتاعك
examples.english: And you, how are you doing today in your work?
examples.transliteration: Wenta amel eh ennaharda fel shoghl betaak
examples.storyTitle: A New Day with the Family

examples.arabic: النهارده الجمعة ومفيش شغل خالص
examples.english: Today is Friday and there is no work at all.
examples.transliteration: Ennaharda el gomaa we mafish shoghl khales.

examples.arabic: قال الكيلو بعشرة جنيه
examples.english: He said the kilo is ten pounds.
examples.transliteration: aal el kilo be ashra geneh

examples.arabic: عمر كان معاه خمسة جنيه بس النهاردة.
examples.english: Omar had only five pounds with him today.
examples.transliteration: Omar kaan maah khamsa gineh bas elnaharda.

examples.arabic: قال لي الكيلو بعشرة جنيه
examples.english: He said to me the kilo is ten pounds
examples.transliteration: aal li el kilo be ashra geneh

examples.arabic: إحنا كنا مبسوطين أوي وعدينا الفلوس مع بعض في الأوضة.
examples.english: We were very happy and counted the money together in the room.
examples.transliteration: ehna kona mabsoteen awy wa adenna el felous maa baad fe el oda.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.arabic: البياع وافق وانا دفعت الفلوس
examples.english: The seller agreed and I paid the money.
examples.transliteration: el bayaa wafeq wa ana dafaat el feloos

examples.arabic: هو دور في جيوبه، بس ملقاش فلوس كتير.
examples.english: He searched in his pockets, but he did not find much money.
examples.transliteration: Howa dawwar fee giyoobo, bas malaqash fuloos kiteer.

examples.arabic: اخويا بيشتغل كتير بس هو عايز يعمل حاجة جديدة في الاجازة
examples.english: My brother works a lot but he wants to do something new on the vacation.
examples.transliteration: Akhoya biyeshtaghal kteer bas howa ayiz yiamil haga gedeeda fel agaza

examples.arabic: القميص حلو اوي بس غالي
examples.english: The shirt is very nice but expensive.
examples.transliteration: el amees helw awy bas ghaly

examples.arabic: بس القميص كان غالي اوي
examples.english: But the shirt was very expensive.
examples.transliteration: bas el amiis kaan ghaali awi

examples.arabic: الطماطم رخيصة بس العيش غالي
examples.english: The tomatoes are cheap but the bread is expensive.
examples.transliteration: el tomatem rkheesa bas el eish ghaly

examples.arabic: أمي بتقولي إن اختيار الفستان زي اختيار رئيس الجمهورية صعب
examples.english: My mom tells me that choosing the dress is as difficult as choosing the President of the Republic.
examples.transliteration: Ommi betʾūli en ekhtiyār el-fostān zayy ekhtiyār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya ṣaʿb.

examples.arabic: مهم نختار رئيس الجمهورية اللي يقود البلد كويس
examples.english: It's important to choose the President of the Republic who will lead the country well.
examples.transliteration: Mohimm nekhtār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya elli yaʾūd el-balad kwayyis.

examples.arabic: هي سألتني تفتكر مين هيكسب وهل رئيس الجمهورية الحالي هيترشح تاني
examples.english: She asked me "Who do you think will win and will the current President of the Republic run again?"
examples.transliteration: Heyya saʾaletni "Teftiker mīn hayeksab w hal raʾīs el-gomhūrīya el-ḥāli hayetrashshaḥ tāni?"

examples.arabic: الكل انفجر من الضحك وواحد فينا قاله وعليكم السلام يا كابتن هو ده الجون الجديد اللي بنلعب عليه ولا إيه
examples.english: Everyone burst into laughter and one of us told him, and upon you be peace, Captain, is this the new goal we are playing for or what?
examples.transliteration: El-kol enfagar men ed-dahk we wahed feena qal-lo wa 'alaykum as-salam ya captain howwa da el-goon el-gedeid elly benil'ab 'aleih walla eih.

examples.arabic: إحنا كنا مبسوطين أوي وعدينا الفلوس مع بعض في الأوضة.
examples.english: We were very happy and counted the money together in the room.
examples.transliteration: ehna kona mabsoteen awy wa adenna el felous maa baad fe el oda.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.arabic: البياع وافق وانا دفعت الفلوس
examples.english: The seller agreed and I paid the money.
examples.transliteration: el bayaa wafeq wa ana dafaat el feloos

examples.arabic: دفعت الفلوس للتاجر ومشيت مع السلامة
examples.english: I paid the money to the vendor and left, goodbye.
examples.transliteration: Dafa't el felous lel taager w mesheet ma'a el salama

examples.arabic: الدكتور قال، "دي خربوش صغير، متقلقوش."
examples.english: The doctor said, "It's a small scratch, don't worry."
examples.transliteration: El doktor aal, "Di kharboosh soghayar, mat2alaqoosh."

examples.arabic: اخويا بيشتغل على الكمبيوتر بتاعه والمطر شغال بره
examples.english: My brother works on his computer and the rain is falling outside.
examples.transliteration: Akhouya biyeshtaghal ala el computer betao wel matar shaghal barra.

examples.arabic: النور في الصالة مش شغال
examples.english: The light in the living room is not working.
examples.transliteration: el noor fi el sala mish shaghghal

examples.arabic: التلفزيون قديم ومش شغال
examples.english: The TV is old and not working.
examples.transliteration: El televisyoun qadeem we mish shaghghal.

examples.arabic: هي معاها تمانين جنيه بس، وقالتله: "يا عمو، طب يعني معلش، مفيش أي حاجة أقل من كده؟ ده أنا طالبة غلبانة ومش هعرف أخلّص المشروع بتاعي من غيره."
examples.english: She only had eighty pounds, and she told him: "Uncle, well, I mean, sorry, isn't there anything less than that? I'm a poor student and I won't be able to finish my project without it."
examples.transliteration: Heya ma3aha tamaneen geneh bas, we qaletlo: "Ya 3ammo, tab ya3ni ma3lesh, mafish ay haga a'all men keda? Da ana taliba ghalabana we mesh ha3raf akhalles el-mashrou3 beta3i men gheero."

examples.arabic: بعدين بدأنا شغلنا ومروة ساعدتني في مشروع جديد كان صعب شوية
examples.english: Then we started our work and Marwa helped me with a new project that was a bit difficult
examples.transliteration: Ba3dein bada'na shoghlina we Marwa sa3adetni fi mashroo3 gedid kan sa3b shwaya

examples.arabic: أحمد كان شاب صغير وكان عايز يبقى فنان مشهور.
examples.english: Ahmed was a young man and he wanted to become a famous artist.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed kan shabb soghayyar we kan ayiz yib-a fannan mash-hoor.

examples.arabic: في الاخر شغلنا الراوتر تاني والوايفاي اشتغل والكل كان مبسوط
examples.english: In the end, we turned the router on again, and the Wi-Fi worked, and everyone was happy.
examples.transliteration: fel akher shaghghalna el-router tani wel-wifi eshtaghal wel-kol kan mabsoot

examples.arabic: كنت تعبانة بس لازم أشتغل
examples.english: I was tired but I have to work.
examples.transliteration: Kont ta3bana bass lazem ashtaghal.

examples.arabic: عماد بصراحة كان حاسس بشكر كبير لكل المجهود اللي اتعمل
examples.english: Emad, frankly, was feeling great gratitude for all the effort that was made.
examples.transliteration: 3emad biSaraHa kan Hasis bi shukr kabeer li kull el maghood elli et3amal.

examples.arabic: الجد بحكمة رد بإن المتعة الحقيقية في المجهود واللمة مش بس في سهولة الوصول للحاجة زي ما الجيل الجديد بيفكر
examples.english: The grandfather wisely replied that the real joy is in the effort and the gathering, not just in the ease of getting things, as the new generation thinks.
examples.transliteration: El-gedd be-hekmma radd be'enn el-mot'a el-haqiqiya fel maghoud wel lamma mesh bas fe sohoolet el-wosoul lel-haga zay ma el-geel el-gedid beyfakkar
examples.storyTitle: Leila's Questions and the Old Generation

examples.arabic: ماما كانت عاملة محاشي بتشهي خدت منها مجهود كبير بس فرحتنا تستاهل
examples.english: Mom had made delicious stuffed vegetables, which took a lot of effort, but our joy was worth it.
examples.transliteration: Mama kanet amla mahashi betshahhi khadet menha maghoud kebir bas farhetna testahel.

examples.arabic: المدير كان مبسوط عشان عملت شغل حلو
examples.english: The manager was happy because I did good work.
examples.transliteration: el modeer kan mabsoot ashan amalt shoghl helw

examples.arabic: انا هتصل بالمدير بكرة عشان اخد اجازة
examples.english: I will contact the manager tomorrow to take a day off.
examples.transliteration: Ana hatessel bel modeer bokra ashan akhod agaza.

examples.arabic: نهلة قالت انا مصرية ممكن ناخد خصم بسيط
examples.english: Nahla said: "I am Egyptian, can we take a small discount?"
examples.transliteration: Nahla 'alet: "Ana masreya, momken nakhod khasm baseet?"

examples.arabic: بعد تردد، قالت: طب، ينفع خصم بسيط عشان أنا طالبة؟
examples.english: After hesitation, she said: Well, can I get a small discount because I am a student?
examples.transliteration: Ba'd taraddod, qalet: Tab, yenfa' khasm baseet ashan ana talba?

examples.arabic: سالت البائع عن السعر وقالي انه عامل خصم حلو
examples.english: I asked the seller about the price and he told me there was a good discount.
examples.transliteration: Sa'alt il-ba'ea aan is-se'r we 'ali innoh aamel khasm helw
examples.storyTitle: A Day of Shopping for New Clothes
